toolDefinitions.name: get_product
toolDefinitions.description: Read product costs (BRL, grams, hours, kW) and provenance. Null is unknown.

toolDefinitions.name: get_channel_rule
toolDefinitions.description: Read separate revenue charge rates, fixed fee, source and validity. No Shopee rules exist.

toolDefinitions.name: calculate_scenarios
toolDefinitions.description: Deterministic C# costs and prices. Margins and discount are fractions. Uses stored product/rule, never model-invented costs. Includes undiscounted and discounted scenarios.

toolDefinitions.name: submit_recommendation
toolDefinitions.description: Submit a draft referring only to successful scenario IDs. No prices are applied. Human approval is required.

toolDefinitions.name: request_clarification
toolDefinitions.description: Stop and ask specific questions when essential data/rules/objectives are missing.

data.summary: For headset-stand under demo-direct, the 5% revenue-margin draft price is BRL 31.38. With no discount, contribution is BRL 1.5753 and achieved revenue margin is 5.02% (essentially at target). With a 10% discount, charged price falls to BRL 28.24 and contribution becomes BRL -1.2507, so the discount makes contribution negative and revenue margin turns negative (-4.43%).
assumptions: Synthetic demonstration data only: product costs from demo-costs-v1 and channel rule from demo-rule-v1; both are marked Demonstration and valid 2026-10-24 to 2026-10-26.
All revenue-side charges in the rule are applied to the charged selling price: 10% channel fee, 0% tax, 0% advertising, plus BRL 2 fixed fee.
Failure provision is included per the stored model using the listed 10% failure rate; the deterministic output already incorporates this assumption.
limitations: Unmodeled overhead is not included beyond the stored product/rule inputs.
Failure model assumes full-print retry treatment as embedded in the stored calculation.
No marketplace verification exists for this synthetic rule, and prices are drafts requiring human approval; no application or publication is possible.
